nodes.description: Read the target investor match (a named firm/contact or a fresh match from mandate-fit scoring) and confirm this run is OutreachPipeline 'investor', not 'customer' — the only pipeline-level change from Chapter 1's sales-outreach.graph.json.

Score mandate fit: ticket size, stage, focus (dual-use + industrial for DWS), exclusions, warm-path availability. Maps to the /investor-outreach skill's COLD/NEW status and the `add` action's required fields (name, firm, linkedin; recommended: role, ticket, stage, focus, warm, drawback, exclusions).
A warm path exists (referrer, portfolio-company connection, conference). Request the intro before drafting cold copy — same warm-vs-cold split Chapter 1 uses for customers.
Warm intro delivered. Draft references the intro context.

Compose the outbound draft from the house INTRO_<NAME>_<FIRM>.md template (`/investor-outreach add`, canonical reference `INTRO_LAURA_RAGGL_ROI_VENTURES.md`) or a matching investor-outreach/ LETTER-style file. Sender identity and signature per CLAUDE.md Sender Identity rule. Transport MUST be Amazon SES per Non-Negotiable Rule 4 — never Resend, same conflict flagged in Chapter 1's scope doc.

RED zone, non-negotiable: outbound investor communication is still outbound email/InMail and requires explicit human approval before send (Auto-Mode Trust Boundary — 'outbound email' is BLOCKED/human-required). Identical enforcement to Chapter 1: the executor must stop and surface the drafted copy verbatim; no auto-transition past this node under any circumstance.

Send the approved draft via Amazon SES (SMTP) or LinkedIn InMail per the intro's chosen channel. Update the INTRO_*.md file's Status field to CONTACTED, matching the pattern already used across investor-outreach/INTRO_*.md files (e.g. "CONTACTED — LinkedIn InMail sent <date>").
Hold state pending reply. A follow-up send is a NEW draft and re-enters HIC_APPROVAL_GATE — never resends without fresh approval (same rule as Chapter 1's AWAIT_RESPONSE).
Investor replied. Classify outcome (interested / needs reframing / declined / referred elsewhere). Maps to `/investor-outreach triage` re-ranking by current focus.
Meeting or call scheduled. Handoff point to a human-led conversation — this graph does not model the meeting itself.
SAFE round terms in discussion (ticket size, valuation cap, pro-rata, board/observer rights).
Terminal — SAFE signed. Feeds the DWS IQ 6 SAFE round total.
Terminal — investor declined or mandate fit disqualified at this stage. Maps to a Status update recording the reason (mandate exclusion, stage mismatch, no capacity).
Terminal for this run, but re-enterable later (e.g. next fund cycle, mandate refresh). Matches the HOLD status pattern already used across investor-outreach/INTRO_*.md files.
Send failed or bounced (wrong address, InMail limit hit). Diagnose and correct before retrying.
